observations: White/silver countertop microwave with mechanical dial controls (no digital display)
Left dial labeled POWER with Low/M.Low/Med/M.High/High settings
Right dial labeled TIMER(MIN) and DEFROST(kg)
Door open in photo 2 showing glass turntable, interior looks clean, warning sticker about piercing food skins visible
No visible brand logo or nameplate on the unit in any photo
Background shows an unrelated box with '32cm' printed on it, not attached to the microwave
Decorative items (flowers, wall signs) suggest a shop/display setting, not an actual kitchen test setup

claims.evidence: No brand name, label, or model plate reading 'George Home' is visible in any of the 4 photos
No UK plug, voltage sticker, or import marking visible in any photo
No capacity label or rating plate is legible in any photo; the '32cm' text in photo 0/1 is on a separate background box, not the microwave

risks.risk: Unit may not heat or power on at all
risks.proof: A video clip of the microwave running with a cup of water visibly heating/steaming

risks.risk: No rating/brand plate visible means model and true specs (wattage, capacity) cannot be confirmed
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rating label usually found on the back or side of the unit
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic unbranded 20L-class unit, lowest comparable tier

risks.risk: Turntable roller ring/support may be missing (only the glass plate is visible)
risks.proof: Photo of the turntable lifted out showing the roller ring underneath
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing accessory, minor deduction

risks.risk: Door seal, hinge, or latch damage not visible from front-on shots
risks.proof: Close-up of door hinge area and a photo of door closing flush
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working, since a leaking or faulty door seal is a safety and functional issue

risks.risk: Possible interior rust or burn marks hidden behind turntable or in corners
risks.proof: Close-up photo of interior floor and side walls with turntable removed
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically worn, no premium for 'clean interior'

proof_requests: Video of the microwave plugged in and running, heating a cup of water
Close-up photo of the rating/brand label (usually rear or side of unit)
Photo of turntable removed showing roller ring and interior floor
Close-up of door hinge and seal with door both open and closed
response.reason: The item is clearly a manual-dial countertop microwave and can be priced at its worst case as an unverified-brand, untested-function unit; the seller's specific brand and working-condition claims are not supported by any photo.
